definitions.gloss: creator; producer; maker (of a creative or media work)
definitions.explanation: A person (or group) who makes a creative work — including films, videos, TV programs, games, websites, artworks, or other media. Emphasizes authorship or hands-on involvement in the creation process. Written in formal, credit-line, or descriptive contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{制作者|せいさくしゃ}です。
examples.english: I am the creator of the program.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{制作者|せいさくしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧だ。
examples.english: The creator of this film is a young director.

examples.japanese: ⟦ウェブサイト→ウェブサイト：05152_webusaito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{制作者|せいさくしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧、⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I contacted the creator of the website and got permission to use the images.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ドキュメンタリー→ドキュメンタリー：05250_dokyumentarii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{制作者|せいさくしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{数年|すうねん}→数年：28206_suunen⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取材|しゅざい}→取材：05227_shuzai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: I heard that the creator of this documentary spent several years doing on-site interviews.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{制作|せいさく}→制作：04320_seisaku⟧ ('production; creation of a work') plus the agent suffix {〜者|しゃ} ('person'). Used across creative industries — film, TV, web, games, art — to refer to the person who makes the work.

USAGE:
Appears in credits, interviews, articles, and formal writing. In casual conversation, role-specific terms like ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧ ('director'), ⟦プロデューサー→プロデューサー：12841_purodyuusaa⟧ ('producer'), or ⟦クリエイター→クリエイター：10871_kurieitaa⟧ ('creator') are usually preferred. {制作者|せいさくしゃ} is a generic, formal cover term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{制作者|せいさくしゃ}: creator of a (TV) program
- ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{制作者|せいさくしゃ}: creator/maker of a film
- {制作者|せいさくしゃ}{名|めい}: creator's name (in credits)
- {制作者|せいさくしゃ}⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧: the creators' side (as in 'from the creators' perspective')
- {制作者|せいさくしゃ}⟦{不明|ふめい}→不明：11352_fumei⟧: creator unknown

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{作者|さくしゃ}→作者：04169_sakusha⟧: author — primarily for literary works and the like
- {製作者|せいさくしゃ}: same reading, different kanji — used for manufactured goods and, traditionally, for film producers in a business/financial sense. {制作} favors the creative/artistic act; {製作} favors manufacturing and financing.
- {作|つく}り{手|て}: maker; creator — more hands-on, artisanal feel
- ⟦クリエイター→クリエイター：10871_kurieitaa⟧: creator — modern loanword, popular for digital/online content
- ⟦プロデューサー→プロデューサー：12841_purodyuusaa⟧: producer — business-side role, often managerial

WRITING:
The distinction {制作} vs {製作} is frequently confused even by native speakers. For artistic works (films, music, TV shows, artworks) {制作} is standard; {製作} is preferred when the emphasis is on mass production, financial backing, or tangible goods.
